entries.title: Joe Biden in the Oval Office with newly-elected mayors FGq2Q3EXwAQiJZ9.jpg
entries.description: "Yesterday, I met with 10 newly-elected bipartisan mayors from across the country to discuss the American Rescue Plan, Bipartisan Infrastructure Law, and more. The country’s mayors and local elected officials are crucial partners when it comes to building back better." Per a White House statement , mayors meeting with Biden that day included: Mayor Jim Ross, Arlington, TX • Mayor-elect Andre Dickens, Atlanta, GA • Mayor Michelle Wu, Boston, MA • Mayor Tim Kelly, Chattanooga, TN • Mayor-elect Justin Bibb, Cleveland, OH • Mayor-elect Aftab Pureval, Cincinnati, OH • Mayor-elect Daniel Rickenmann, Columbia, SC • Mayor-elect Eric Adams, New York City, NY • Mayor-elect Bruce Harrell, Seattle, WA • Mayor-elect Ken Welch, St. Petersburg, FL
entries.creator: White House

entries.title: President Joe Biden goes over the week-ahead plan with advisers in the Oval Office on Sunday, October 1, 2023 after Congress avoided a government shutdown.jpg
entries.description: President Joe Biden goes over the week-ahead plan with advisers in the Oval Office on Sunday, October 1, 2023 after Congress avoided a government shutdown late the night before by passing a stopgap funding bill that keeps the government open for another 47 days through November 17, 2023. (Official White House Photo by Adam Schultz)
entries.creator: The White House

entries.title: Old Downtown Post Office, exterior views, 2019 - DPLA - 4304c7cfd2ede8cc17657e999f439754 (page 1).jpg
entries.description: These images are exterior views of a building originally constructed as the downtown branch of the United State Post Office in Toledo. The building has also been owned and used by Toledo Public Schools. The building was designed by J. Knox Taylor, and construction ran from 1909 to 1911. The photographs were taken on April 2, 2019.
entries.creator: Dewees, John Michael
